title: FINRIX – Open-Source Quantitative Research Terminal for XAUUSD (PyTorch TFT & Modal Cloud)
author: carnoba
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to share an open-source quantitative research and execution terminal I built for XAUUSD (Gold), called FINRIX.

It combines a local CPU baseline with a serverless Modal A10G Cloud GPU backend to perform real-time forecasting, strategy replay, and dynamic risk management through a Rich CLI interface.

# Key Features & Architecture:

* Neural Forecasting Core: Powered by PyTorch NeuralForecast Temporal Fusion Transformers (TFT) with $\\sqrt{t}$ Geometric Brownian Motion Monte Carlo corridors for forward price estimation.
* Execution Engine: Generates daily trade execution cards with entry zones, dynamic stop-losses, multi-stage take-profit targets, and equity-based lot sizing.
* 14-Strategy Replay Suite: Replays SMC (FVGs & Order Blocks), RSI, Supertrend, Ichimoku, and EMA setups across 15m, 1h, 4h, and 1D horizons.
* Institutional Risk Rules: Implements standardized 100 oz/lot contract math, 2.0-pip round-trip transaction costs (spread + slippage), and zero-lookahead .shift(1) volatility parity sizing.
* Macro Sentiment: Integrates FinBERT NLP models for real-time macro news sentiment scoring.
* DevSecOps & QA: Includes 207 unit tests with automated GitHub Actions CI and SonarCloud compliance.
